title: 👀 Doomsday plane (74-0787) coming into sight: closest in about 6 min, look SW, about 76° up, 6 mi away
body:
@RDBFarm — Doomsday plane (74-0787, E-4B Nightwatch) is worth looking for from the farm (2026-10-29 21:22:32 UTC).

- **At its closest** (in about 6 min): look SW (bearing 223°), about 76° above the horizon, 6.0 miles away, about 30,490 ft up
- **Right now:** NW (bearing 323°), 56.1 miles away, about 30,863 ft above the farm's ground, heading SE, 501 kt
- **Callsign:** not broadcast; ICAO ADFEB5

[ADS-B Exchange](https://globe.adsbexchange.com/?icao=adfeb5) · [Farm receiver (farm network only)](http://192.168.1.190/tar1090/?icao=adfeb5) · [Live map](https://rdbfarm.github.io/iad-map/live.html)

_Automatic alert from `pi/alerts.py`, once per visit. Its path is projected straight ahead at its present course, speed and climb or descent; it alerts only when that path is in sight (within 12 miles, at least 5° up) within 5 minutes for at least a minute. Those limits are estimates; a turn changes the path, and cloud isn't known._
